method.loadTimeMs: performance.now() at the assignment of window.careerPrototype, installed with Object.defineProperty before Page.navigate. Counted only when #loading is absent, #manual is enabled, the stage canvas buffer width is > 0, #game-title is non-empty, and snapshot().state is not loading or error. timeOrigin is the navigation start of GET /games/career-rpg/web/?chapter=hefei on a fresh profile.
method.inpMs: Max PerformanceEventTiming.duration among scored gestures in a run. Observer type "event"; durationThreshold is recorded per run (0 if accepted). Entries must have interactionId > 0 and startTime inside the gesture window (performance.now() just before the trusted CDP keydown, through 250ms after keyup). Gestures: walk-right, walk-left, walk-down, walk-up (80ms taps), walk-hold-right (400ms), handbook-m, dialogue-e (boss), skill-e (collect Linux). Reported value is the median of run INPs.
